\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch3:3-12↗ ex:invariant-metrics-lie-groups Regard the upper half-space $\mathbb {H}^n$ as a Lie group as described in Example 3.16(f).

(a) Show that for each $R > 0$, the hyperbolic metric $\bar{g}_R$ on $\mathbb {H}^n$ is left-invariant.

(b) Show that $\mathbb {H}^n$ does not admit any bi-invariant metrics.

(Used on pp. 68, 72.) \end{exercise}
